facts.fact: FaceBuilder (KeenTools add-on for Blender) 2021.1 release added auto-alignment: a couple of neural networks find the face in the photo and set up all required pins. Per the thread, developers said results are not always 100% accurate, so manual adjustment is sometimes needed. (Taken from the search-result summary of the thread; not verified by opening the page.)
A later revamp of FaceBuilder automatically sets the focal length and sensor size for each photo, reducing setup work. (From search-result summary; page not opened.)
FaceBuilder's newer feature set includes support for facial expressions, so neutral photographs are not strictly required, though the thread's summary says neutral photos still give better quality.

Forum users describe FaceBuilder as a paid add-on (not free); one mentions a 30-day trial. Pricing and trial terms may have changed; the search summary advises checking keentools.io. Not confirmed from a primary source.
A community add-on, MetahumanModeler, is reported to generate a 3D model with Metahuman topology from a single image; its author says it was built from their understanding of FaceBuilder.

BlenderArtists threads exist on single-photo face/character generation: AutoFace (create rigged and textured character from a single photograph) and general 'model human face from random photos' threads. Only titles were seen; no methods or numbers were retrieved.

contradictions: Pricing: forum posts call FaceBuilder paid and mention a 30-day trial; no current primary pricing source was checked, so the current status is unresolved.
